name: Bounty Hunna Bloods
description: Bounty Hunna Bloods (BHB) is a small, Blood-affiliated street clique based near 8 Mile in Detroit, active approximately 2012–2013. The set maintained alliances with YGB, LTC, and CTM, and rivalries with Bandcrew, TSN, RTM, CMH, HoodRich, and WildLife, and was named as a rival in a Hoover Criminals indictment. The set is now fully inactive.

sources.title: Profiles of Major Neighborhood Street Groups in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
